changelog: Fixes transcription, which was broken in 0.1.63. If you installed 0.1.63, please update: the app started and looked completely normal, but transcribing anything - a recording from your phone, or a meeting on this PC - failed, and nothing warned you until you tried. 0.1.64 fixes it, verified by transcribing three seconds of silence, which now correctly produces nothing at all. That test matters: the previous speech engine used to answer silence with "Thank you." and file it away as though someone had said it. The new one stays quiet.
